allowedCidrs.description:
AllowedCIDRs is the inbound client-IP allowlist (IPv4 CIDRs). Pointer so
the service can tell "omitted" (nil -> allow-all default) from an
explicit empty array (block all). Each entry must be a valid IPv4 CIDR;
the list is capped at 50. `dive` validates each element of the slice
(the *[]string + dive form is also used for AllowedCIDRs in UpdateGatewaySpecRequest).

hostAliases.description:
HostAliases is the user-supplied /etc/hosts override list applied to the
gateway pods. Omitted = empty array (no overrides). Each ip must be IPv4
and each hostname a valid RFC-1123 name; capped at 50 entries / 10
hostnames each. ip and hostname uniqueness are enforced in the service.

clientRedirectUris.description:
ClientRedirectURIs is the MCP-client leg redirect_uri allowlist, enforced
at DCR /register and /authorize. Non-loopback entries must be http(s)
URLs; loopback (127.0.0.1/::1/localhost) is auto-allowed at request time
regardless of this list. Whole-object replace on create/PATCH.

jwt.description:
JWT is required when mode=JWT (enforced by required_if) and may be
omitted when mode is NONE or IAM. A stale block sent with another
mode is dropped silently — callers toggling modes do not need to
clean up their payload.

idpApp.description:
IdpApp carries the OAuth client at the upstream IdP. ClientSecret is
write-only: it is encrypted server-side and never returned over the wire.
Omit IdpApp to leave any stored IdpApp untouched (preserve-if-absent is
enforced by mergeOrchestratorFields, not here).

mode.description:
swaggertype:"string" suppresses swag's $ref to domain.InboundAuthMode so
the inline enum from `oneof` is the only enum on the property — without
it Swagger UI shows the values twice (once from the $ref, once inline).

privateNetwork.description:
PrivateNetwork is required when networkMode=PRIVATE and must be omitted
(or null) when networkMode=PUBLIC. Enforced by required_if /
excluded_unless binding tags.

publicEndpointEnabled.description:
PublicEndpointEnabled opts a PRIVATE gateway into an internet-reachable
endpoint. Meaningless for PUBLIC (which rejects the whole privateNetwork
block), so it is structurally PRIVATE-only.

routes.description:
Routes is an optional list of IPv4 CIDRs (e.g. "172.16.0.0/12") that the
kube-worker will program as node routes inside the PRIVATE gateway's pod
network. Each entry must be a valid IPv4 CIDR (IPv6 is rejected at the
binding layer). The hard cap of 50 entries is enforced here; semantic
checks (overlap, vs admin/user VPC CIDR) run in the service / saga layer.

subnetId.description: SubnetID is a subnet within the referenced VPC.

vpcId.description: VPCID is a VServer VPC identifier owned by the caller.

targets.description:
Targets count cap is enforced in the service layer against the
operator-configurable gateway.maxTargets — DTO stays shape-level only
per the type doc above. `dive` still validates each element.

endpoint.description:
Endpoint must be an absolute http:// or https:// URL (hostname or
IP:port host both accepted). The scheme is mandatory — a bare
host[:port] is rejected so callers state the protocol explicitly.
URL shape and length cap are enforced by domain.Target.Validate()
in the service layer.

customParameters.description:
CustomParameters is forwarded verbatim to the identity service when
resolving an OAUTH + 3LO secret. Keys/values are opaque to the gateway —
the upstream provider decides what they mean. Ignored for any other
(Type, Flow) combination and stripped by Normalize.

allowedCidrs.description:
AllowedCIDRs uses JSON Merge Patch semantics: absent (nil) = no-op,
a present array replaces the stored allowlist. An explicit empty array
means block all client IPs. Each entry must be a valid IPv4 CIDR (max 50).

displayName.description:
DisplayName and Description: nil (absent / null) preserves the stored
value; a non-nil pointer replaces — pass "" to clear, any non-empty
value to set. Format checks (length + charset) on non-empty values run
inline in the handler. Swagger renders them as strings with x-nullable.

hostAliases.description:
HostAliases uses whole-list replace semantics: absent (nil) = no-op, a
present array replaces the stored list (explicit [] = clear all
overrides). Validation matches CreateGatewayRequest.

clientRedirectUris.description:
ClientRedirectURIs is the MCP-client leg redirect_uri allowlist, enforced
at DCR /register and /authorize. Non-loopback entries must be http(s)
URLs; loopback (127.0.0.1/::1/localhost) is auto-allowed at request time
regardless of this list. Whole-object replace on create/PATCH.

swaggertype:"string" suppresses swag's $ref to domain.InboundAuthMode so

policyGroupId.description:
PolicyGroupID uses JSON Merge Patch semantics: absent = no-op,
JSON null = clear, non-empty string = set. The binding tag is bypassed
because Nullable[string] is not a string; format (refid + length)
and the rejection of empty strings are enforced in the handler before
the service is called. Swagger renders it as a string for the
happy-path documentation.

privateNetwork.description:
PrivateNetwork is the PRIVATE-only mutable block (block-replace; both
sub-fields required when present). Omit to leave routes + toggle alone.

targets.description:
Targets count cap is enforced in the service layer against the
operator-configurable gateway.maxTargets (see CreateGatewayRequest).
